idea-plugin.name: Docker Hub Pull Limit Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds every anonymous Docker Hub pull in GitHub Actions, compose, GitLab CI, Kubernetes and Dockerfiles, including the service containers your login step never covers. Docker Hub limit: 100 pulls per 6 hours per IPv4 address or IPv6 /64 subnet (docs.docker.com, checked 2026-09-27).

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Docker Hub Pull Limit Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 10 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/docker-hub-pull-limit-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/docker-hub-pull-limit-lint

action.text: Docker Hub Pull Limit Lint: Check This File
